source_text.slice: REQ-519 slice 2f-b (GH #2535): on becomes settable (parse_mode/modes, the flip/4 transition table, PUT authority = interactive tenant-wide TENANT_ADMIN via Api.Scope.require_interactive_tenant_admin/1, 409 shadow_required and enforcement_precondition_failed bodies, GET /integrity rescue, docs/roles.md). Tests only; nothing under lib/ or priv/ was changed; nothing committed.

task.description: Write the test spec and test code for REQ-519 slice 2f-b (design r2a 2f-b rows, T-X*, T-H*, T-O*, T-Z*, T-RW*, T-E15 and the mutants assigned to 2f-b), ACs 8, 13, 16-24, the SEC step-21 merge conditions and the REVIEWER step-22 notes (F-4 rename, TS-1); clean up and prevent the stale on tenants of the shared local test database. Per-file runs only under the shared mixlock; no mix letflow.check.test, no full or multi-partition suite; mutants applied in memory only.

result.summary: 102 new tests in 6 new files plus 1 new test (TS-1) in the renamed on_flip_guards_test.exs, ALL GREEN, run per file, one mix at a time under the mixlock (MIX_ENV=test, default LOG_LEVEL): scope_enforcement_transitions 36, routers/tenant_scope_enforcement_on 22, scope_enforcement_flip_authority 14, api/route_scope_on_flip_blocker 8, docs/roles_on_flip_docs 14, scope_enforcement_on_e2e 8, on_flip_guards 17. The neighbours stay green and UNEDITED by this step: scope_enforcement_test 23, routers/tenant_scope_enforcement_test 26, on_gate_test 35, refused_audit_test 13, tenant_scope_enforcement_integrity_test 9, plugs/auth_pipeline_scope_test 7 (T-P5 passes at the default log level), routers/service_principal_route_test (inside the mutant runs, 18 tests), api/admin_plane_under_on_test 8, api/scope_grants_route_walk_test 9. No compiler warning in any run. mix format --check-formatted exit 0 on every file this step created or edited. 48 mutants measured in memory: 40 killed, 8 survived (MU-37a/b/c/d single-check removals of require_interactive_tenant_admin/1, MU-53, MU-T-O8/b/c), every survivor a single removal from a defence-in-depth stack and analysed in the spec; the PAIR mutants of the same stack are killed. One of my own tests was VACUOUS and was found by a surviving mutant (MU-37bc): the platform-tenant row of the authority matrix built its reference tenant after the pin, and building a tenant clears the platform pin; fixed (reference first, pin asserted) and re-measured KILLED. NOT RUN by instruction: mix letflow.check.test, full or multi-partition suites (the warnings-as-errors dead-default check was therefore not run; no helper added in this step has a default argument, and every run printed no compiler warning). No implementation bug found; one wording deviation from AC 13 reported (OBS-2).

stale_on_tenants_cleanup.found: three tenants stored on (slugs req519-n5-mix*) in the shared local test database; scope_enforcement_on_test.exs T-O1 migration-down tests failed with 'rollback refused: 3 tenant(s) are stored as on' (14 of 16 passed before)
stale_on_tenants_cleanup.cause: test/letflow/identity/binding_no_row_report_test.exs T-N5 (the mix task output) commits an on tenant and runs Mix.Tasks.Letflow.BackfillRoleScopeGrants.run/1, which calls System.halt(1) when a tenant fails; a halt skips every on_exit, and TenantAdminMigrationFixture.isolate_registrations!/1 had removed the registrations the suite-boundary reaper works from, so nothing reclaimed them. All other tests that store on use provisioned_tenant! tenants whose on_exit teardown drops the schema and the row

implementation_findings: NO IMPLEMENTATION BUG FOUND: every test is green against the working tree and every mutant that should be killed is killed.

OBS-1: the ACs/design say a missing or BLANK reason on on -> shadow / on -> off is reason_required (AC 13: 'missing or blank: reason_required'); the implementation answers reason_required only for a MISSING (nil) reason and invalid_reason (also 422) for a blank, whitespace-only, multi-line or over-long one (Audit.Reason.validate), exactly as stage 1 did for off. Both are 422 and nothing is written. The tests pin the implementation (T-X9). If the AC wording is the intent, this is an ELIXIR-DEV change; otherwise DOC-UPDATER should align the AC text.

OBS-2: require_interactive_tenant_admin/1 has four overlapping checks; no single check is load-bearing for every caller class (see the survivors). Harmless and arguably desirable; pinned by pair mutants.

OBS-3: the post-on lockout of SEC step-21 F-1 (the last-admin guard counts token owners while the flip route needs an interactive admin) is not asserted by any test, to avoid pinning a defect; it is an accepted follow-up.

OBS-4 (environment): the shared mixlock directory was absent at the start; this session created it with mkdir and removes it after the last mix command. Scratch scripts (mutant loader, runners, logs) live in the session scratchpad, not in the repository.

OBS-5: the entities records API is not driven for the AC 8 'generic API cannot set the column' clause (it cannot reach the tenants table); the two tenant APIs that can (PATCH /tenant/settings, PATCH /tenants/:slug) are, and the Tenant changesets are pinned by scope_enforcement_on_test T-O5.
